# Lorenzo De Francesco - Full Profile

> Technology leader, tech speaker, and community organizer with 10+ years of experience in fintech, cloud architecture, and enterprise software development. Currently leading the technology development at TNB Project (Gruppo Azimut) and CTO at Azimut Marketplace.

## Bio

Lorenzo De Francesco turns IT from a cost center into a strategic asset. He is a CTO with 10+ years in fintech and banking. In finance, trust is the real product, and technology either protects it or puts it at risk; the hardest problems he deals with are rarely technical: they are about governance, cost, risk and people. At TNB Project (Gruppo Azimut) he leads the technology development of Italy's first wealth management bank, where AI works for the financial advisor, and business teams build the apps they need with AI within rules that keep every app compliant with banking regulations. Before that, as CTO of Azimut Marketplace, a CONSOB-regulated fintech platform where he still leads technology, he built the IT department from scratch, cut recurring IT costs by about 70% (over €700k) and wrote the IT policies required by Bank of Italy and CONSOB. He works on regulated platforms that stay secure and auditable as they grow, AI and agents in regulated environments, technology compliance (DORA, NIS2, AI Act, GDPR, ISO 9001), making IT speak the language of the CFO and the board, and engineering teams with a strong technical culture.

He is one of the organizers of the Google Developer Group Milano and Scientific Coordinator of the Master in Full Stack Development & AI at start2impact.

---

## Career

### IT Manager, Technology Lead — TNB Project (Gruppo Azimut) (May 2025 – Present)
Milan, Italy. Leads, from scratch, the technology development of Italy's first wealth management bank, where AI works for the financial advisor, with a relentless focus on cyber security, data governance and data integrity. Brought vibe coding into a regulated bank: business teams build their own apps with AI on an internal control tower he coordinates, automating manual processes that used to take days, each one compliant with banking regulations by design. Leads data integration with partner banks and fund distribution platforms, and oversees compliance with GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 9001 and the AI Act.

### CTO — Azimut Marketplace (May 2022 – Present)
Milan, Italy. CONSOB-regulated fintech platform serving SMEs. Built the IT department from scratch, cut over €700k (~70%) of recurring IT costs, turned a software development lifecycle governed by a single Excel file into an orchestrated Agile process on Azure DevOps, wrote the full IT policy framework required by Bank of Italy and CONSOB, and mentored two engineers into technology leaders.

### CTO — Sula Inversiones (Gruppo Azimut) (January 2024 – February 2026)
Madrid, Spain, remote. Designed from a green field the wealth-management platform of the Group's Spanish branch and supervised a team of five, on Azure with Kubernetes, SQL and NoSQL databases, Service Bus queues and Blob Storage.

### Architect & Team Leader, SME Banking — Fabrick (Gruppo Banca Sella) (November 2020 – May 2022)
Milan, Italy. Within the Sella banking group, coordinated the development of SME Banking, leading a team of 8 engineers and mentoring junior developers. Defined and maintained the foundational React architecture and the shared component libraries powering the group's banking products. Member of the technical committee that moved the group's platforms from bare metal to the cloud.

### Senior Software Developer — Costa Crociere (August 2018 – October 2020)
Genova, Italy. Built mission-critical, real-time web applications for the maritime industry and the CI/CD pipelines to deploy and update software directly on board cruise ships — operating in constrained, high-stakes environments where downtime is not an option.

### ILS and Maintenance Engineer — Delfi/Fincantieri (January 2017 – August 2018)
La Spezia, Italy. Integrated Logistic Support Technical Writer for the Italian Navy. Supplier management, spare parts identification, and writing maintenance manuals for complex systems.

### Co-Founder & CEO — Navium (January 2015 – December 2016)
Trieste, Italy. Co-founder of a startup developing decision support products for the cruise shipping market. Funded by POR-FESR 2020 Program (€300k).

## Side Projects

### Opsburg
Keep your cloud up and running. Play it like a city. A self-hosted platform for platform engineers, DevOps teams and SREs: it builds and ships apps and AI agents from the repository to Kubernetes through GitOps, under rules set once for the whole organization. The console is a 3D steampunk city builder: every service is a building, every deploy an airship, every incident a storm. Status: in development.
- Apps and AI agents from approved templates, repositories on GitHub, GitLab or Azure DevOps
- GitOps deploys via Argo CD, with rollback
- AI agents that read logs and propose fixes, with human approval before production
- Single sign-on, roles, your own AI models, MCP server for AI clients
- Self-hosted on your Kubernetes
- Website: https://opsburg.dev/
- GitHub: https://github.com/opsburg

### Swagger Aggregator
A Kubernetes-native service that automatically discovers Ingress resources, retrieves associated services and pods, and aggregates their Swagger API definitions into a unified interface.
- Auto-discovery of Ingress resources
- Active pod validation
- Swagger definition merging, Redis caching
- Helm chart deployment
- GitHub: https://github.com/Lory1990/swagger-aggregator

## Client & Side Projects

### Tryvium
Crypto-friendly booking platform. Online booking for hotels and accommodations with crypto payments. Role: Head of Frontend Development. Stack: React, Web3, CSS. Website: https://tryvium.io

### Tongy
Platform to teach English to babies through fun interactive activities and native speaker lessons. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: AWS, React, Docker, Node. Website: https://tongy.it

### Autoconnexa
InsurTech platform with mileage-based car insurance and vehicle tracking. Role: Team Leader. Stack: AWS, React, Docker, Node, Stripe. Website: https://autoconnexa.it

### Spire Energia
Platform to monitor building energy consumption for condominium administrators. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: VPS, Node, Stripe. Website: https://spire-energia.com

### Newo
Fintech web application for invoice advance, allowing businesses to get cash on outstanding invoices. Role: Head of development. Stack: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Node, React, Stripe. Website: https://newopay.it

### Duck Internship
Internship marketplace connecting graduates with practical work experience. Role: Full Stack Developer. Stack: VPS, Node, React. Website: https://duckinternship.com

### The Personal Trainer
PWA fitness tracker for personal trainers and athletes. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Docker, Node, React.

### Comunicazione per PT
Personal trainer online video portal with YouTube integration and PayPal payments. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Docker, Node, React.

### CryptoForecast
Platform to predict cryptocurrency prices, centralizing all useful trader information. Role: Head of development. Stack: VPS, Node, React, PHP.

### Navium
Marine tech startup specialized in damaged stability prediction and naval design software. Role: Head of development. Stack: Java.
